entries.author: Swadim
entries.note: CV90120-T at IDET (Brno), right front quarter: the CV90 hull, a low wedge turret over the hull centre, the long 120 mm gun with thermal sleeve and perforated muzzle brake, the commander's sight ball on the roof. Exhibition camouflage, not followed.

entries.author: generated
entries.note: Generated: proportions of the turret over the hull in the Swedish splinter scheme (asked for a side view, it drew a right front quarter). Layout only.
entries.prompt: BAE Systems Hägglunds CV90120 light tank, straight left side view at eye level, on open ground in daylight, photographic reference. Same vehicle as the input photo: CV90 tracked hull with seven road wheels a side and front drive sprocket, a low angular two-man turret set over the hull centre with a long 120 mm smoothbore gun with a perforated muzzle, the commander's sight on the roof, a turret bustle. Swedish green and black splinter camouflage instead of the exhibition finish. Whole vehicle in frame, no people, no text.

entries.author: Spike78
entries.note: CV90120-T at MSPO 2007 (Kielce), head-on from the left track: the CV90 nose and glacis under a wide turret whose faceted cheeks stand well out beside the narrow gun shield, the commander's sight on its post above. Grey trial camouflage, not followed.

entries.author: Spike78
entries.note: CV90120-T at MSPO 2007, left front low: the hull's bolted side skirts and nose, and the turret's left cheek, a long faceted wedge running back from the gun shield to the flat side; the thermal-sleeved 120 mm.

entries.author: Spike78
entries.note: CV90120-T at MSPO 2007, from above the turret's right cheek: the wedge cheek and its sight window either side of the gun shield, the sleeved barrel and perforated muzzle brake over the CV90 glacis and deck.
